# Bundled browser dependencies

These pinned upstream distributions are served locally so the game does not depend on third-party CDN availability at play time. Copyright and license banners are retained in each distribution.

- CreateJS 1.0.0: https://code.createjs.com/1.0.0/createjs.min.js (MIT)
- jQuery 3.6.0: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jquery@3.6.0/dist/jquery.min.js (MIT)
- Bootstrap 5.1.1 CSS: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.1/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css (MIT)
- Bootstrap 5.1.1 bundle JS: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.1.1/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js (MIT)
